cluster.description: Cluster name, exactly as returned by list_clusters.

end.description: Range end, same forms as start. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum exemplars to return across every matching series. Exemplars are returned most-recent first.

query.description: A PromQL selector, e.g. http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api"}. Exemplars attach to a raw series, not to an aggregation: wrapping this in rate() or sum() returns nothing.

start.description: Range start. Relative ("now-1h") or RFC 3339. Defaults to now-1h.
